business_problem: Unity Environmental University wanted to keep scaling enrollment and student support, but slow inquiry responses, fragmented records across legacy systems and PDFs, and manual advising tasks made it hard to serve more students without adding staff and cost.
solution_summary: Unity Environmental University is combining a centralized Salesforce student information system with Data Cloud and Agentforce to give prospective and current students always-on support across recruitment, advising, and registration. Data from CAMS, Donor Perfect, spreadsheets, and other systems is unified so recruiters and advisors no longer search disconnected records for program, transcript, tuition, or aid questions. Agentforce uses that data layer to answer natural-language questions, recommend programs, schedule info sessions, support multilingual enrollment, and eventually assist with class registration and career guidance using private university data plus public sources like LinkedIn. By shifting routine questions and admin tasks into the digital labor layer, staff can focus on deeper outreach while the university scales enrollment and speeds admissions decisions.
data_flow: Student and applicant data from CAMS, Donor Perfect, spreadsheets, and other systems is unified through Data Cloud into Salesforce, where Agentforce can answer questions, route students to the right program or advisor, and automate routine support steps from inquiry through registration.
business_outcome: Unity reduced advisor and recruiter workload, accelerated registration and admissions workflows, and created a more accessible enrollment experience for first-generation, multilingual, online, and nontraditional students.
architecture_clues: Agentforce is planned to use both private university resources and public data such as LinkedIn for later-career guidance.
Data Cloud is the layer unifying CAMS, Donor Perfect, Excel, and other university systems.
The student information system is the execution surface for registration and advising workflows.
evidence_quotes: By implementing Salesforce's as a centralized student information system and Data Cloud to integrate their many systems, Unity could consolidate all student data into one platform.
Agentforce will analyze the student's preferences and program data to provide a tailored recommendation.
Students can now register for courses in under 20 seconds.
Applicants can expect to hear back within 48 hours - much faster than the typical eight-week wait at most universities.
